lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 14 to 16 distinct vertical white line segments. Spacing is relatively uniform across the central torso, with increased density and narrowing towards the anterior shoulder and posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Visible dashed and fragmented segments occur on the posterior-most lines (12-16), where lines transition into localized spots near the lower ventral region and haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8 to 10 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior flank and upper hind limb, varying in diameter.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three distinct spots is visible mid-way down the posterior haunch, roughly parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white patches are visible on the lower limbs (fetlock area); a white chevron-like mark is visible on the bridge of the nose; a distinct white-furred underside is present on the tail.
